pr_body:
Changes introduced in https://github.com/rails/rails/pull/43232 break SVGs
that have mulitple of the same descendant tag because they weren't being
closed. SVG elements must be closed accodoring to spec
https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/syntax.html#elements-2.

Fixes https://github.com/rails/rails/issues/44563

issue_context.title: SVG tags generated with tag helper are not self closing
issue_context.body:
### Steps to reproduce Generate HTML using this code to output an SVG: ``` tag.div(style: "height: 100px; width: 100px") do tag.svg(viewBox: "0 0 100 100", xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg") do tag.g(fill: "white", stroke: "green", "stroke-width": "5") do tag.circle(cx: 40, cy: 40, r: 25) + tag.circle(cx: 60, cy: 60, r: 25) end end end ``` ### Expected behavior `` tags inside the SVG should be closed. ```
``` SVG should look like ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/21263/155895035-787f3854-a017-4b01-bb40-c639dd247421.png) ### Actual behavior `` tags are not closed. ```
``` The browser ends up nesting the `` tags like: ```
``` The final SVG looks like: ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/21263/155895127-2b5529b7-f987-47b8-b0e1-5ed6a0022e6e.png) Changes introduced in Rails 7 in https://github.com/rails/rails/pull/43232 broke this SVG. I think the changes are not correct. Only [void elements](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/syntax.html#void-elements) can omit the end tag. Tags inside SVG elements are not considered void elements but rather are [foreign elements](https://dev.w3.org/html5/html-author/#foreign-elements) (elements in the SVG namespace). These elements must be closed with either an end tag (like they were before the change), or by self-closing like ``. ### System configuration **Rails version**: 7.0.2.2 **Ruby version**: 3.1.1
comments:
Yeah, that change sounds wrong. 

Would you like to open a PR that reverts it, and adds some new tests to protect the better behaviour? 

We could possibly retain the new list of SVG-related likely-empty tags, and special-case them to be self-closing, just to make the output look more like people expect. But they were also perfectly valid before, and the code is simpler without an extra special case. 🤷🏻‍♂️
Great I will try making a PR. Thanks for the input.
